svg.script:
const timeline = gsap.timeline(); timeline.set("#svgContainer",{opacity:1},0.05) timeline.set("#text_certainty",{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0,x:-50,y:50, opacity:0},0) timeline.set("#text_low_cost",{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0,x:-50,y:-50, opacity:0},0) timeline.set("#text_values_based",{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0,x:50,y:-50, opacity:0},0) timeline.set("#text_self_managed",{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0,x:50,y:50, opacity:0},0)
timeline.to("#dial",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",rotate: 106},1.4) timeline.to("#text_certainty",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 1,x:0,y:0,opacity:1},1.4) timeline.to("#text_low_cost",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},1.5) timeline.to("#text_values_based",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},1.7) timeline.to("#text_self_managed",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},1.8)
timeline.to("#dial",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",rotate: 186},2.4) timeline.to("#text_certainty",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},2.4) timeline.to("#text_low_cost",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 1,x:0,y:0,opacity:1},2.5)
timeline.to("#dial",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",rotate: 264},3.4) timeline.to("#text_low_cost",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},3.4) timeline.to("#text_values_based",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 1,x:0,y:0,opacity:1},3.5)
timeline.to("#dial",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",rotate: 360},4.4) timeline.to("#text_values_based",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 0.8,x:0,y:0,opacity:0.6},4.4) timeline.to("#text_self_managed",0.4,{transformOrigin:"center center",scale: 1,x:0,y:0,opacity:1},4.5)
